title: Lu Dort headed to Hawks, Zaccharie Risacher to Mavericks in 3-team trade: Sources
content:
Lu Dort and Ryan Nembhard are headed to the Atlanta Hawks, while Zaccharie Risacher is bound for the Dallas Mavericks in a three-team trade that will send a collection of second-round picks to the Oklahoma City Thunder, a league source confirmed to The Athletic.

The Thunder will receive three second-round picks in the deal, which will see Dort leave Oklahoma City after a seven-year run that included an All-Defensive Team selection and NBA championship. Risacher was selected with the top pick in the 2024 NBA Draft by the Hawks, but is now leaving Atlanta after just two seasons.

This story will be updated.
